headline: Oasis Tradelink postpones board meet to Nov 13
summary: Oasis Tradelink Ltd has postponed its board meeting scheduled for November 7, 2026, to November 13, 2026. The meeting was originally set to approve Q2FY27 financial results.

headline: Deccan Gold subsidiary signs refining deal
summary: Avelum Partner LLC, a subsidiary of Deccan Gold Mines, has signed an agreement with Kyrgyzaltyn for gold refining. The first 1.2 kg dore consignment has been dispatched to validate procedures.

headline: Neogen Chemicals gets GPCB consent for Dahej plant
summary: Neogen Chemicals received a revocation of direction and provisional consent from GPCB for its Dahej SEZ plant on November 7, 2026, following the March 2025 fire incident.

headline: Authum Investment releases Nov 2026 corporate presentation
summary: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited filed its corporate presentation for November 2026 with BSE and NSE on November 8, 2026. The document, titled 'Making the Big Leap', was submitted by the Company Secretary.

headline: JTL Industries advances Maharashtra expansion
summary: JTL Industries completed hot trial of Pickling Line and started cold trial of GP Line at Mangaon facility, supporting 30% FY27 growth target.

headline: Suvidhaa Infoserve completes rights issue dispatch
summary: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited completed dispatch of issue materials for its 78.67 crore equity share rights issue on November 6, 2026.

headline: Saurashtra Cement gets ₹1.91 Cr GST notice
summary: Saurashtra Cement received a show cause notice for ₹1.91 crore regarding non-payment of GST on royalty charges for FY23. The company states the demand is not maintainable.

headline: South West Pinnacle H1FY27 PAT up 23%
summary: South West Pinnacle Exploration reports 16% revenue growth and 23% PAT rise in H1FY27. Record order book of ₹7,671 million supports strong H2 outlook.

headline: Zee Learn CEO Manish Rastogi exits on superannuation
summary: Zee Learn Limited announced the cessation of Manish Rastogi as CEO and Whole-time Director effective November 8, 2026, due to superannuation.

headline: Alkem Labs incorporates JV subsidiary in Saudi Arabia
summary: Alkem Laboratories has incorporated 'Alkem Pharma Company', a joint venture subsidiary in Saudi Arabia. The entity holds 51% stake with a capital of SAR 75 lakh.

headline: Jubilant Ingrevia acquires 40% stake in Zettaone
summary: Jubilant Ingrevia subsidiary JAEL executed an agreement to acquire 40% equity in Zettaone Technologies, with an option to increase holding to 51% in FY28.

headline: RO Jewels directors resign effective Nov 7
summary: Bharat Rasiklal Shah and Pravinaben Bharatbhai Shah resigned from RO Jewels Ltd board citing personal reasons. The resignations are effective November 7, 2026.
